system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Processes the farmer's premium payment for PMFBY. For your information, my payment_mode is dummy_payment_mode_8075, my policy_id is None.

function.name: pmfby_pay_premium
function.description: Processes the farmer's premium payment for PMFBY. Transitions policy_status from 'enrolled' to 'active' upon successful payment. Requires session_token. This tool does NOT calculate premium — use pmfby_calculate_premium first. Fails if premium has already been paid, policy is not in 'enrolled' state, or payment processing encounters an error.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

policy_id.description: Unique identifier of the insurance policy.
